init_multiprocessing_training_stats: initialize training stats for collecting statistics across multiple processes with rank and sync device
report_training_scalar: report a named scalar statistic to all Collector instances across device and process boundaries
report0_rank_zero_scalar: broadcast a named scalar statistic from only the first process with rank zero
collector_update_and_query: update the Collector to sync internal counters and query mean, std, or num for a statistic
collector_as_dict: get all collected training statistics as an EasyDict with num, mean, and std per name
